{{Quote|Meet your new best friend--the S86k full-gauge carbonite armor upgrade.|[[Crysta Markon]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:AMT" />}}
The '''S86k full-gauge carbonite armor upgrade''' was a [[carbonite projector]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] attachment that was used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Crysta Markon]] gave [[Hunter (individual)|the bounty hunter]] she was working with during the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] a S86k for use in capturing [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] alive.<ref name="TOR:AMT" />
